name: Lisa Lytton
source:
The Gamerican reporter, who appears in the very various places of Universe and in pursuit for sensations. She can go (or in certain circumstances even sneak in) everywhere and no one can stop her (but, well, sometimes she can be caught after). She can do everything to get a scoop, even illegal actions! Though her doings not always went unpunished...

"One, two... Test-test...
The microphone is good.

I'm Lisa.
Lisa Lytton.
A Gamerican reporter".
